chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 360 – Han Li Acquires the Rare Red-Line Light-Speed Needles
chapter_meta_description: Han Li ascends to the sixth floor of the Stardust Pavilion, expecting a powerful elder—but finds a mortal girl. He purchases a set of legendary flying needles and a perfect pill formula, signaling a new phase of preparation.
og_description: Chapter 360 of A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality: Han Li surprises a privileged mortal girl by flawlessly activating the notoriously difficult Red-Line Light-Speed Needles.
twitter_title: The Shadow Tool Purchase – RMJI Ch. 360
twitter_description: Han Li finds a thirteen-needle assassination set that no cultivator could use… until he casually proves them all wrong. Cold, calculated, classic Mortal Stream.

lore_anchors.definition: A set of thirteen crimson flying needles that can only be activated simultaneously. In the cultivation world, such needle tools are rare and prized for their stealth and assassination potential, earning them the nickname 'shadow tools.'
A standard Foundation Establishment pill formula suited to Han Li’s current needs. The ingredients are easy to find, but the price reflects its rarity and value.
An ancient pill formula previously provided by Lei Wanhe, now considered useless to Han Li but still a valuable antique in the cultivation world's peculiar economy.

The hidden barrier that makes the Red-Line Needles unusable for most cultivators. Only those with exceptional spiritual sense can command all thirteen at once, making it a high-floor, high-ceiling weapon.
A derogatory nickname for flying needle magic tools, reflecting their association with underhanded ambush tactics rather than honorable combat in cultivation culture.
